digest.component_or_area: Ruff linting configuration and timezone semantics
propositions: Enable Ruff ASYNC and DTZ rule families in the global linting configuration after resolving all six current diagnostics (three in src/rebar, three drift-introduced in tests).
Validate timestamp semantics as UTC by converting integer epoch seconds with datetime.timezone.utc and interpreting persisted timezone-less strings as UTC wall time before clustering.
Prove timezone invariance by executing validation behavior under at least two distinct TZ values using time.tzset on supported POSIX/macOS platforms, with explicit skip on unsupported platforms.
Preserve security-rule cadence as a host-local calendar-date decision by obtaining an aware current instant with explicit tz argument, converting to host timezone, and extracting the date.
Prohibit the literal datetime.UTC token in production code and require datetime.timezone.utc for py310 target; enforce via test assertion that recursively scans src/rebar Python files.
Ensure DTZ005 compliance in security-pin detection and verify that age_days == cadence_days is not stale while age_days > cadence_days is stale.
